title: Repo-committed statusLine command prints env secrets to the UI
reason_not_testable: The statusLine command runs outside the tool-call pipeline, so there is no tool_response for PostToolUse or PreToolUse to see. Whether UI output reaches the model is UNVERIFIED. Non-hook control: review committed .claude/settings.json before trusting a repo, pin statusLine in managed settings, and keep env dumps out of statusline scripts.
